portableDeviations.description: The project format preserves click types 128..255 as unsigned integers and maps the dialog's displayed 256 to portable 0. Java stores the spinner value in a signed byte, so 128..255 reopen as negative values and 256 wraps to 0; reproducing those reopen and downstream defects would make portable projects unstable.
